interface_lengths (family-wide defaults):
IProvider=1: GetProxyCreator only (observed 13/13 concrete pattern
providers, all next-vftable-bounded). RefcountBase=2: [vector dtor,
Init] (observed 13/13 pattern providers). Interface method COUNT is
an ABI contract fact, not derivable from a single binary when the
tail is unobservable.
class_interface_lengths (class-scoped subobject-table lengths):
The ElementProvider family's RefcountBase@1@ subobject is a
DIFFERENT shape from the pattern family's: its table carries the
introduced virtuals [dtor, GetProxyCreator, GetElement, TossElement,
Init] (ElementProvider, 5 slots -- next-vftable-bounded by the
Simple2 table) and HWNDElementProvider appends a 6th slot (its
Init(HWNDElement*) HIDES ElementProvider::Init(Element*) -- a new
virtual, bound by the primary FragmentRoot table).
The ?$BaseElementProvider<TouchSelect...> template tables and their
concrete sharers (TouchSelectProvider 5 slots @0x114A40;
TouchSelectPopupProvider 6 slots @0x114AA8) have the same shape,
bounded by the next vftable in-binary; the family-wide default (2)
would deny visible slots -- under the schema-3 fail-closed rule
that configuration is REJECTED (manual-conflict), never truncated.
